title: Threshold representation of DNF evaluation
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb{N}$, let $\varphi$ be a DNF formula on $n$ sign coordinates, and let $x$ be an input. The value of the formula at $x$ equals the threshold sign of one half minus the number of terms satisfied by $x$.
